openQuestions.q: Is actual Codex and Antigravity/agy launch/dispatch/pre-apply integration in scope for B-9089, or should this story only add adapter modules and guardrails?
openQuestions.evidence: The source plan says to route Codex and Antigravity/agy launch/dispatch paths through the adapter, but the current checklist/plan only names adapter modules, owner-lease/lifecycle files, and docs/guide-scope-guard as a relatedDoc.

openQuestions.q: Should B-9089 initialize a formal Lattice scope contract from the PLAN file boundary before DEV, or is the fail-open scope_contract state intentional for this story?
openQuestions.evidence: scope_contract_show reports no configured scope contract and scope_contract_check skips, while the story touches owner-lease/lifecycle paths where the execution boundary matters.
openQuestions.resolution: Yes. A formal enforce-mode scope contract must be initialized before DEV from the PLAN file set and explicit exclusions, so guard_session_check and lifecycle scope checks have a concrete boundary instead of skipping.

openQuestions.q: Are runtime-fact-registry.ts and command-ownership-contract.ts expected touchpoints for this story, or should they be removed from understanding.touchpoints until a checklist item claims them?
